thread:
alex: quick q — do we want a 'cache savings' line on the model card in the cost canvas? thinking per-model+per-route exposure
maya: +1, product teams keep asking for more visibility. Question is whether it should be absolute $ or percent of model token cost
sam: accuracy concern. cache attribution isn't perfect; sampling and KV-prefix hits get messy. we can show estimate + confidence
alex: agree on estimate + confidence badge. also need to think about routing: if a request falls back to cheaper model, who gets the saving? per-route or per-model?
tina: UX: if we show per-route, card gets noisy. Maybe default to per-model with toggle to split by route
maya: toggle sounds good. also can we add hover with 'how we calculate' + equations? teams love that
sam: telemetry work: pipeline currently tags requests with model_variant, route, cache_hit boolean. but we only log sample of token-level KV hits due to volume
sam: proposal: compute per-request estimated savings in batch worker -> store per-epoch aggregates. accuracy improves with larger windows
cost-bot: snapshot: last 24h aggregate errors ~6% on inferred prefetch savings (sampling rate 1%)
alex: ok that suggests we can ship an initial estimate. need API change: expand /costs/model?start=&end=&group_by=route|model to return 'estimated_cache_savings' field
tina: devex ask: can we avoid a breaking change? maybe add new field and v1 doesn't break consumers
maya: rollout plan: beta to internal teams -> opt-in toggle in console -> retro after 2 weeks
sam: ops note: add flag to router to tag fallback_reason so we can attribute routing deltas later
alex: action items: sam to spec telemetry aggregation + error bounds, tina to mock up toggle + hover microcopy, maya to draft rollout email. I'll file API PR after specs
maya: thanks, will sync next Wed
alex: :thumbsup:
